items.q: What should you remember about **Prompt = one answer; loop = recursive goal** until objective stop condition met?
items.a: **removes human from the daily re-prompt cycle.**

items.q: Why does this matter: **Best loop candidates:** production error triage (Sentry/CloudWatch), analytics-driven conversion work (PostH?
items.a: **Best loop candidates:** production error triage (Sentry/CloudWatch), analytics-driven conversion work (PostHog), SEO maintenance (Semrush) — all have **verifiable external state** as stop signal.

items.q: What should you remember about **Integrations are the moat**?
items.a: **loops need real production data sources** and deploy paths; MCP + manual prompting replicates but doesn't automate the daily ritual.

items.q: What should you remember about **Parallel loops**?
items.a: **multiple independent stop conditions** can run simultaneously (7 in demo).

items.q: What should you remember about **Iteration caps**?
items.a: **optional max iterations (10** shown) as safety rail alongside stop condition.

items.q: What should you remember about **Shipped outcomes without hand-holding**?
items.a: **Sentry loop → v3.4** release; SEO loop → PR with Semrush-backed changes.

items.q: What should you remember about **Claude Code /goal acknowledged**?
items.a: **same family as goal command;** BridgeMind argues integrated product beats raw harness goals for ops loops.
